additional_requirements: Sleep quantity or quality is unsatisfactory to the patient (Criterion A).
Clinically significant distress OR interference with important functioning is required (Criterion B).
Sleep difficulty occurs at least 3 nights per week (Criterion C).
Sleep difficulty persists even with sufficient opportunity to sleep (Criterion E).

Another sleep-wake disorder does not better explain the insomnia, and insomnia is not confined to that disorder (Criterion F). Examples include narcolepsy, breathing-related or circadian sleep disorders, and parasomnias.
Substance or medication effects do not account for the insomnia (Criterion G).
Coexisting mental or medical conditions do not sufficiently explain the chief insomnia complaint (Criterion H).
